aliases.SCRATCH: The owned disposable /var/tmp prefix; its host-specific suffix is omitted.
aliases.ENV: env followed by every entry in isolation.environment, with shell expansion of the declared path aliases.
aliases.UV_BIN: Directory returned by dirname of mise which uv; use the real executable before isolating XDG config.
aliases.NODE_BIN: Directory returned by dirname of mise which node; read-only existing interpreter.
